capabilities: Render mermaid blocks as themed cards in reading view and live preview
Switch diagrams between ELK and Dagre layout engines globally or per diagram
Zoom and pan diagrams with Ctrl/Cmd+scroll and drag, plus an expanded resizable viewer
Export diagrams as 2x PNG or SVG and copy image or source
Define custom themes as Mermaid themeVariables JSON and per-diagram directives
disambiguation: Not a diagram editor or Mermaid code formatter; it only changes how existing ```mermaid blocks are rendered.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly) and verified against Obsidian 1.14.4 only; live preview takeover relies on undocumented Obsidian internals. Bundles its own mermaid 12 build, making main.js several MB. Warns that only one plugin taking over mermaid blocks should be enabled.
intentEvidence: Reading view uses the standard mermaid code block processor (registered ahead of Obsidian's own)
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid rendering uses Dagre and a plain look, pins flowcharts to the reading-column width, and offers no zoom, export, or per-diagram theming.

relations.evidence: Disabling the plugin restores Obsidian's own Mermaid rendering.

summary: Mermaid renderer replacement that draws mermaid code blocks as styled cards with ELK layout, zoom and pan, an expanded viewer, and PNG/SVG export.
